text:
nora_csm: Reminder: Pegasus Inc dedicated bring-up tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need final quota, autoscale knobs, and a short soak plan we can share with their oncall.

devin_infra: Proposal: start with 8x A40 reserved, allow autoscale up to 12. Customer wants minimal commit week1. I can prepare expected hourly burn.

sam_account: Confirmed with Pegasus: they'll sign 8 reserved if we can autoscale to 12 for spikes and cap cost delta < 20% week1. They'll watch 24/7.

ash_sre: Autoscale rules I'd recommend:
- scale out +1 when avg GPU util > 72% for 120s
- scale out aggressive +2 if request queue > 600ms for 90s
- scale in -1 when util < 34% for 600s
- cooldown 3m between ops; max 3 scale ops per 15m

leo_ml: Load profile we should run for the soak: 55% chat (1k tokens), 25% embeddings, 20% short gen. Seed set: s3://pegasus/onboard/seeds-v4.txt. QoE thresholds: p95 < 2.4s, error rate < 0.8%.

nora_csm: @leo_ml paste the loadgen command and I'll forward to the customer's SREs. Also need a short canary plan.

leo_ml: loadgen example:
```
loadgen --target https://dedicated.redwood/pegasus --qps 180 --duration 3600 \
  --profile mixed --seeds s3://pegasus/onboard/seeds-v4.txt --concurrency 48
```

devin_infra: I'll prewarm kernels and KV cache 25m before start. prewarm cmd:
```
./infra/prewarm.sh --pool pegasus --minutes 25
```

infra-bot: Provision event scheduled: 1807773600  pegasus-dedicated-provision

ash_sre: Canary: 1 instance handles 4% of traffic for 8m, then 12m ramp to 30% before full. Fallback: route to hosted family if p95 > 3s for 2 consecutive mins. Also enable short token-bucket shaping to smooth bursts.

sam_account: I'll send the calendar invites to pegasus-eng and their oncall. Also sharing the week1 cost estimate after infra posts instance-hour burn.

devin_infra: Will tag dashboards with customer:pegasus env:dedicated and stream perf to #ops-dashboard. Posting expected instance-hours in 10m.

leo_ml: If we see >2% 429s, drop qps by 15% and check cache hit ratio. Capture sample outputs for post-run evaluation.

nora_csm: Great — quick final check at 09:00 PT for go/no-go. Please add any runbook links or run scripts here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
